head: DELETE → 409 hosted_turn_active; the passive load answers 200. Then every POST /managed-runtime/cancel → 409 hosted_turn_recovery_required → CANCELLING: the resident Session is still blocked (#13054)
h1: DELETE → 204; it released nothing (the lease was not recorded yet). Spring's retry cold-loaded, re-acquired the same Runtime identity, cancel 200 → CANCELLED at +43.7 s; both Runtime records RELEASED
